summary: Repository-aware coding products implement this pattern through durable instruction files, scoped rules and indexed repository context. They are useful substrates, but teams still have to maintain the structure and test whether retrieval improves.

items.text: OpenAI Codex AGENTS.md: repository-scoped instructions let teams place durable context near the code to which it applies.
Claude Code CLAUDE.md and rules: hierarchical project memory and path-scoped rules provide a practical structure-to-context interface.
Cursor Project Rules: version-controlled, scoped rule files can attach context to directories and file patterns.
GitHub Copilot repository instructions: repository-wide and path-specific instruction files expose project conventions to coding agents.
